name: gis_create_layer
description: Create an editable WGS84 vector layer with attribute schema; stable operation UUID.

name: gis_schema
description: Add or rename a field on a pinned source.

name: gis_export
description: Export a pinned layer as GeoJSON to the user's browser downloads.

name: gis_layers
description: List active project layers, schemas, capabilities and revision pins. Start here.

name: gis_features
description: Page features and attributes from a pinned layer; WGS84 geometry. Small pages for large geometry.

name: gis_query
description: Filter by typed attribute AST (e.g. {op: eq, field: name, value: A}) or spatial predicate with WGS84 geometry; no raw SQL.

name: gis_feature
description: Read one feature with current content/schema pins.

name: gis_geometry_preview
description: PostGIS CAD and analysis preview: move, copy, offset, rotate, scale, stretch, extend, trim, fillet, intersection, union, difference, centroid, hull, simplify, nearest, spatial join. No persistence. Use gis_changeset to commit reviewed output.

name: gis_topology
description: Find duplicates, invalid geometry, overlaps, dangles, outside or gaps. No persistence.

name: gis_overlay
description: Draw temporary WGS84 geometry on the live map; no persistent editing.

name: gis_layer_visibility
description: Show or hide a project layer in the current workspace.

name: gis_select
description: Select loaded, visible objects by layer and pinned feature IDs.

name: gis_changeset
description: Atomically create, update or delete up to 100 features on one editable layer. WGS84 geometry; properties replace the full attribute map. Use current pins and a stable unique operation UUID. Requires explicit GIS approval.

name: gis_raster_layers
description: List project raster layers and metadata.

name: gis_raster_process
description: Create a raster result from saved project rasters: NDVI/NDWI/NDBI, band, DEM, clip, RGB, mosaic, calculator, resample etc. Returns operation ticket.

name: gis_raster_report
description: Compute zonal statistics or contour from an existing raster. Returns operation ticket.

name: gis_raster_download
description: Download authorized project GeoTIFF in browser.

name: gis_processing_run
description: Run Buffer, Clip or Dissolve with existing vector processing engine. Creates output layer; returns operation ticket.

name: gis_processing_job
description: Read durable vector processing job status and output layer.

name: gis_models
description: List saved Processing Modeler graphs.

name: gis_model_save
description: Create or update revision-pinned Processing Modeler graph (up to 12 steps).

name: gis_model_run
description: Run saved graph at exact revision, producing independent output layers; returns operation ticket, partial outputs possible.

name: gis_layouts
description: List saved cartography Layout Designer documents.

name: gis_layout_save
description: Create/update revision-pinned print layout: A0–A4, map frames, text, legend, scale, north, grid.

name: gis_layout_export
description: Render and download saved layout at exact revision as PDF, PNG or JSON. Returns operation ticket.

name: gis_plugins
description: List project activations and organization registered extension manifests and entity schemas.

name: gis_plugin_activate
description: Activate an existing registered extension on this project; requires project management permission.

name: gis_plugin_disable
description: Disable project's active extension; requires project management permission.

name: gis_plugin_records
description: List authorized extension records, optionally by entity.

name: gis_plugin_create
description: Create a record through the active extension schema using idempotent operation UUID.

name: gis_plugin_update
description: Update extension record with expected revision and manifest, existing schema and permissions.

name: gis_revert
description: Revert a specific GIS changeset using a new operation UUID. Requires explicit GIS approval and server authorization.
